title: A quiet morning
text: Maya opened the window and listened to the rain. The street was empty, but the small bakery across the road was already full of warm light. She smiled because the day felt slow and kind.

title: The letter
text: When Daniel found the letter under the old clock, he did not open it at once. He knew it belonged to his grandfather, and something about the careful handwriting made him feel that the past was suddenly very close.

title: A small decision
text: Although the train was leaving in ten minutes, Nora stayed on the platform and watched the crowd move around her. For the first time that week, she understood that running away would not make the problem smaller.

title: The hidden room
text: The door, which had always looked like part of the library wall, opened with a tired sound. Behind it was a narrow room filled with maps, notebooks, and the strange smell of dust after rain.

title: A difficult truth
text: By the time the meeting ended, everyone understood that the mayor had not simply made a mistake; he had allowed a small fear to grow into a decision that would change the whole town.

title: The argument
text: What made the argument painful was not the anger itself, but the fact that both sisters recognized, even as they spoke, how many years of silence had gathered behind their careful words.
